rows.note: For a person or group one knows without necessarily being close to, this is the all-purpose noun.

example.english: That person is an acquaintance from my previous company.
example.traditional: 嗰個係我以前公司嘅熟人。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 hai6 ngo5 ji5 cin4 gung1 si1 ge3 suk6 jan4

rows.note: Use this when the focus is on the degree of personal relationship, especially when saying it is not very deep.

example.english: We have only a slight acquaintance; we used to be colleagues.
example.traditional: 我同佢得少少交情，係以前同事。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 dak1 siu2 siu2 gaau1 cing4 hai6 ji5 cin4 tung4 si6

rows.note: Use this noun phrase when the focus is on how much one knows about a person or subject rather than on the relationship itself.

example.english: My acquaintance with this place is still pretty shallow.
example.traditional: 我對呢個地方嘅認識仲好淺。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 ge3 jan6 sik1 zung6 hou2 cin2
